global_claude_md_sections: BSO Canonical Positioning — required reading for ANY strategic work
Before Any File Creation or Tool Pipeline — MANDATORY
Cloud deploy — дефолт Vercel + Supabase, не переоткрывать — MANDATORY
Communication style — outcomes, not engineering log — MANDATORY
Copy-paste content — fenced code block, never inline backticks — MANDATORY
Data-derived numerical claims in client deliverables — MANDATORY same-turn pipeline run
Decision framing — PM language, not engineering — MANDATORY
Hook message authoring — MANDATORY (prevent autonomous agent execution)
Language rule — MANDATORY (BSO English, personal Russian)
Linear/Notion — локальные stdio-серверы; «requires auth» на старте ≠ выключено — MANDATORY
MCP/API error ≠ rollback — MANDATORY (verify final state)
Monitoring requests → event-driven watcher, never timer-poll — MANDATORY
Scope erosion in delegation — MANDATORY (do not soften user instructions when delegating)
Secret Handling — MANDATORY (NEVER request secrets in chat)
Subagent delegation — WHEN to use — MANDATORY
URLs in chat — bare clickable, never in backticks — MANDATORY
Writing Style — Tone of Voice (MANDATORY for all client-facing documents)
spawn_task chip for new CC sessions — MANDATORY
Визуальная проверка — по умолчанию, не по запросу (MANDATORY)
